notes:
CRM notes (shorthand & call excerpts):
- Company: mid-market product analytics platform. Heavy realtime search + user-facing chat.
- Primary driver: reduce inference cost w/o sacrificing p99 latency; need predictable throughput for peak events.
- Evaluation path: started on Hosted API for fast proof, now moving to Dedicated POC for predictable tail latencies and data isolation.
- POC ask: Dedicated pool (2 GPUs reserved) for 4 weeks; canary routing for 10% traffic, soak to 50% if stable.
- Canary plan (agreed 02/24):
  * Phase 0: smoke (internal traffic) — sanity checks, KV cache warm up.
  * Phase 1: 10% production routing to Dedicated variant A (quantized 8-bit) for 48h. Monitor errors, quality regressions on 5 canonical prompt sets.
  * Phase 2: 10% traffic -> variant B (fp16 unquantized) in eu-west to validate cross-region latency; run for 24h.
  * Phase 3: ramp to 30-50% only if p99 latency < 250ms for chat endpoints and accuracy delta < 2% on rerank eval.
  * Rollback policy: automatic rollback to Hosted if two consecutive 5-minute windows exceed p99 SLO by >30% or if failure rate >0.5%. Manual rollback if quality regressions flagged by product team.
  * Fallback routing: region failover (us-east -> eu-west) configured with transparent variant mapping; model compatibility matrix prepared by SE.
- POC acceptance criteria (customer):
  * p50/p95/p99 targets for chat: <= 60ms / <=120ms / <=250ms
  * Reranking throughput: sustained 700 qps with median latency <35ms (batching config TBD)
  * Cost goal: target <=50% of current per-token cost at equivalent quality.
  * Security: VPC peering + SSO/SAML + audit logs available in console + KMS integration verified.
- Quotes from CTO (Alexei Dubrov): "We need predictable tail behavior during load spikes — spikes kill conversions."
- Pricing convo: AE sent Dedicated starter SOW + commit tiers; finance asked for 12-month vs. 36-month pricing scenarios.
- Open items:
  * Legal to return SLA redlines (expected 1 week).
  * Infosec follow-up on data residency mapping for EU customers.
  * SE to provide exact kernel/quantization compatibility list for customer model variants.
- Next concrete tasks: finalize SOW, provision staging Dedicated cluster, upload 3k sample conversations for eval, run 48h canary starting week of 2026-03-10.
- Internal notes: prioritize routing-doc update (canary runbook) and add automated rollback hook to alerting runbook.
sales_notes_summary: Host->Dedicated path. POC focused on canary + model variant testing + region failover. High cost sensitivity. Legal & Infosec are current gating items.
